trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Micah: Brandi and I have guarded this passage since the day it opened. Nobody has slipped between us yet!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Micah: Brandi! One got through!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Brandi: Micah talks. I battle. Shall we?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Brandi: ...Micah will never let me hear the end of this.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Desiree: In the dark the mind sees furthest. I watched you come all the way from the door.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Desiree: I saw you coming. I did not see you winning.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Landon: Desiree looks ahead, and I look into the here and now. Here and now, you battle me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Landon: The here and now has turned out badly.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Eddie: The old man and I spar in this cave from dawn till dusk! Fresh opponents are a treat!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Eddie: A treat! Even beaten, a treat!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Terrell: The lad has the muscle and I have the years. Let me show you which counts for more.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Terrell: Neither, against you. Well fought.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Arthur: Past here it's daylight and Route 224. You'll have to earn the fresh air!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Arthur: Earned. Breathe deep when you get out there.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Clarice: Poison, fire and steel. Arthur says my team makes no sense. Does it have to?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Clarice: Perhaps it does have to.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Deandre: Something followed me into this cave years ago, and never left my side. Would you like to meet it?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Deandre: It liked you. That is rare.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Kendra: Did you hear a bell just now? No? Then it rang for you. Battle me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Kendra: The bell has stopped. So have I.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Autumn: My birds don't mind the dark. They were night birds long before I caught them!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Autumn: Even night birds have their off nights.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Dragon Tamer Joe: A cave this deep is just where a dragon ought to live. I've brought two!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Joe: Two dragons down. I'm going to need a deeper cave.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Willie: I punch this rock a thousand times a day! It hasn't broken yet! Will you?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Willie: You're harder than the rock!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Brenden: Shell, scale and hide. My three have stood in this passage longer than you've been a trainer.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Brenden: And now they'll stand aside. Go on through.
